name: Inspect immutable entry fields
command: flock -s dumps/run-jfr-38/.matindex.lock java -Xmx3g -jar experiments/shapes/build/libs/shapes-experiment-all.jar mat-fields --hprof dumps/run-jfr-38/daemon.hprof --class 'com.google.common.collect.ImmutableMapEntry' --limit 5 --all > /tmp/immutable-fields.log; flock -s dumps/run-jfr-38/.matindex.lock java -Xmx3g -jar experiments/shapes/build/libs/shapes-experiment-all.jar mat-fields --hprof dumps/run-jfr-38/daemon.hprof --class 'com.google.common.collect.ImmutableMapEntry$NonTerminalImmutableMapEntry' --limit 5 --all >> /tmp/immutable-fields.log; wc -c /tmp/immutable-fields.log
